questions.question: Before starting work in a mechanical room, what should a technician do first?
options: Check the work area for hazards
questions.explanation: A safe work environment starts with identifying hazards such as poor ventilation, electrical risks, trip hazards, hot surfaces, or moving equipment.

questions.category: A2 - Use PPE and Safety Equipment
questions.question: Which PPE is most important when brazing copper tubing?
options: Safety glasses, gloves, and fire-resistant protection
questions.explanation: Brazing creates flame, heat, sparks, and UV exposure. Eye, hand, and heat protection are required.

questions.category: A3 - Perform Lock-Out and Tag-Out Procedures
questions.question: The main purpose of lock-out/tag-out is to:
questions.explanation: Lock-out/tag-out protects workers by ensuring equipment cannot be accidentally started while being serviced.

questions.question: Why should nitrogen be flowed through copper tubing while brazing refrigeration lines?
options: To prevent oxidation inside the tubing
questions.explanation: A low flow of nitrogen prevents black scale from forming inside the tubing, which can damage valves and compressors.

questions.category: B1 - Use Hand Tools and Equipment
questions.question: Which tool is commonly used to tighten flare nuts without rounding them?
questions.explanation: Flare nut wrenches grip more sides of the nut and reduce damage.
